criteria.requirement: Add markdown.documents.convert_file(input,output=None,input_encoding="utf-8",output_encoding="utf-8",close_input=False,**options), building on the earlier real ConversionResult API. Accept string/PathLike paths, standard text/binary input streams from the current cursor and standard text/binary output streams; decode/encode once with independent explicit encodings. Keep caller streams open unless close_input is explicitly true, never close output or retry a failed write with another type. Owned path IO closes itself; return the actual structured result. Prepare encoding before touching output paths, use same-directory temporary flush/fsync+replace, preserve existing mode, reject symlink/nonregular output and clean temporary files. Read/convert/encoding/replace failures remain explicit and keep old output bytes before replacement. Existing file APIs are unchanged.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
